# Architecture

spec

The pipeline is: load the JSON files, check the built-in and kind schemas, build the reference graph, run the rules (block codes and the version hashes of links and code tags among them), render, and compare the output folder.

The code is one Rust crate with a single binary and a small set of modules under `src`.

The speed targets are in [Performance](performance.md).

## Packages

loader: a strict JSON parser that keeps offsets, positions and duplicate keys.

config: reads `docc.json` and resolves effective levels.

schema: compiles JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), restricts references to the schemas folder and maps errors to source positions. `kind.rs` reads a kind schema: whether it is strict, the allowed top-level names, `x-docc-target` and `x-docc-covered`.

mdscan and text: scanners for code blocks, references with their version hashes, includes, block codes, words and sentences.

engine: loads a project and runs all checks, including the graph and the suppressions. `versions.rs` computes the version hashes of targets and reports DOC209 with the change found in Git, `trace.rs` the fingerprints of code (DOC402), `migrate.rs` gives codes to blocks and moves a project of the old format; `lock.rs` only reads an old `docc.lock` for the move.

rules: the registry of all rules; explain, rules and the skill are built from it.

render: Markdown pages, the tree, the single Markdown file, the HTML application (`app.js` with Preact and htm from `vendor`, fed with a JSON island), numbering and images. `lang.rs` holds the Russian labels for `"lang": "ru"`.

history: reads the Git history of the documents (one `git log` and one `git cat-file --batch`) and follows every block through it with the one alignment of blocks, `ops`, which the HTML history, `docc log` and `docc diff` share; changes: the output of `docc log` and `docc diff`; comments: the readers' comments in `$comments`, their shape (DOC112) and place (DOC215), the in-place edit of `docc comments apply` and the export of the HTML file.

trace and report: `docc:` tags in code files, and the text and JSON reports.

source: where the files of a project are read from, the disk or the tree of a Git revision (`docc compile --rev`, with `git ls-tree` and one `git cat-file --batch` for many files); config, schema, engine, trace and render read every file through it.

cli: the command line; its flags behave as those of the Go version, which docc was first written in. The changes of the move to Rust are listed in `docs/rust-port`.

## Principles

Golden tests, a pure core with input and output at the edges, and stable codes. The main dependencies are jsonschema, regex, comrak (it parses the Markdown of the single HTML file; docc writes the HTML itself), icu_collator for sorting titles and unicode-normalization.
